terra.problem: “The others said the people were too strong” implies that all the other spies disagreed with Caleb. Joshua also urged Israel to trust the LORD and enter the land (Numbers 14:6–9). Say “the other spies” or “most of the spies” instead.
“Congregation” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader. In “Leaving for Mount Hor,” use “all the Israelites” instead.
